description:
Apple backend declares ResourceLimits: true (apple.go line 440) but Create() never parses or applies them. ExtraArgs from creator.go are built for nspawn syntax and ignored.

Needed:
- Map cpuQuota/memoryMax/tasksMax to Apple Container CLI flags
- Parse resource limits from CreateOptions.ExtraArgs or add dedicated fields
- Validate limits are applied (inspect output should reflect them)
- Fix the false capability declaration or implement the feature
title: Apple runtime: implement resource limits (CPU/memory)
